correction.v1_change_1: five global attention layers reduce physical KV heads from 3 to 1
correction.v1_change_2: all twenty SwiGLU intermediate widths increase from 2304 to 2325
correction.confound: the parameter-matched candidate estimates MQA1 plus uniform FFN reallocation, not cache representation alone

geometry_source.derivation: load the resolved five-cache KDA/GQA model, change only each attention branch num_key_value_heads from 3 to 1 in memory, clear expected_parameters, and call the existing parameter_count and flops_per_token(4096)

arms.only_model_change: the five attention num_key_value_heads values change from 3 to 1

compound_changes: the five attention num_key_value_heads values change from 3 to 1
all twenty SwiGLU intermediate widths change from 2304 to 2325

decomposition.raw_MQA_effect: mqa1_raw minus gqa3; total deployable compression effect with FFN width held at 2304 and intrinsic parameter/FLOP savings retained
decomposition.FFN_compensation_effect: mqa1_param_match minus mqa1_raw; effect of adding 21 SwiGLU units per layer within MQA1
decomposition.matched_compound_effect: mqa1_param_match minus gqa3; fixed-parameter architecture comparison with no pure MQA1 attribution
decomposition.identity: matched_compound_effect equals raw_MQA_effect plus FFN_compensation_effect within every paired cell
decomposition.MLA_effect: nope_mla128 minus gqa3 after implementation geometry is re-audited

analysis.quality_multiplicity: Holm correction across the three shared-control candidates
analysis.decomposition_contrast: mqa1_param_match minus mqa1_raw reported with paired two-sided 95% interval and no standalone selection authority
all_views: time and energy to locked quality

decision_rule.raw_passes: MQA1 may receive representation-level attribution only if mqa1_raw passes every quality/capability gate and its realized systems threshold
decision_rule.raw_and_matched_pass: choose the cheaper non-dominated MQA1 variant; the compensation contrast determines whether extra FFN capacity earns retention
decision_rule.raw_fails_matched_passes: mqa1_param_match may remain a compound architecture candidate, but no result may claim MQA1 alone preserved quality
decision_rule.matched_fails_raw_passes: retain mqa1_raw and report the FFN compensation as harmful or unresolved under its corrected interval
decision_rule.both_MQA_fail: retain gqa3 unless independently implemented MLA passes every gate
decision_rule.MLA: apply the inherited 20% custom-runtime threshold only after implementation and correctness qualification

registration_boundary.reason: do not mutate the active finalist language ledger during a live cell; register v2 only in a future clean program successor before any cache-representation training

decision.next_action: after the active language sequence, register this successor without changing its hashes; materialize all four arms and qualify correctness/systems geometry before training
